correctness.rationale: Schatten p-subadditivity for 0<p<=1 reduces the full ideal multiplier to rank-one inputs. Direct 2x2 reduction yields exact trace and determinant data. Strict symmetrization at fixed s+t follows monotonicity of largest singular value and total singular sum, then a direct p-power derivative. The one-variable logarithmic derivative is strictly decreasing on the relevant interval and negative thereafter; hence one unique optimizer, attained by a positive rank-one projection. Algebraically checkable endpoints agree with 15,007 finite checker assertions. Finite checks are not used to prove infinite-dimensional assertions.
